articles.title_en: The Next Chapter of Big Data in Finance
articles.abstract_en: The second special issue on big data in finance showcases advancements in research related to data of large size, high dimension, and complex structure since the first NBER/RFS big data conference. The papers published in this next chapter address some questions that were proposed in the initial special issue in 2021. Other papers are more directly connected to recent developments in the markets. We discuss some new research directions, following on the papers published here. They include evaluating market microstructure reforms, understanding medium-frequency trading, improving missing data imputations, and deepening data valuation. We look forward to more developments to follow.
articles.abstract_cn: 第二期金融大数据特刊展示了自首次NBER/RFS大数据会议以来，关于大规模、高维度和复杂结构数据研究的最新进展。本期发表的论文解答了最初特刊中提出的一些问题，这些问题可追溯至2021年。其他论文则更直接地与市场近期发展相关联。我们讨论了基于此处发表论文的一些新研究方向，包括评估市场微观结构改革、理解中频交易、改进缺失数据插补以及深化数据估值。我们期待后续有更多发展。

articles.abstract_en: Fractional trading (FT)—the ability to trade less than a whole share—removes barriers to high-priced stocks and facilitates entry by capital-constrained retail investors. We observe a surge of tiny trades, measured using off-exchange one-share trades, among high-priced stocks compared to low-priced stocks after FT is introduced to the U.S. equity markets. These tiny trades, when coordinated during attention-grabbing events, are forceful enough to exert large price pressure on high-priced stocks. Further evidence suggests that FT can even fuel meme-stock-like trading frenzies and bubbles in high-priced stocks, for which the feedback effect likely plays a role. (JEL G10, G12, G14, G18, G32, G41)
articles.abstract_cn: 零碎交易（FT）——即交易不足一整股的能力——消除了高价股的障碍，并促进了资金受限的散户投资者的进入。我们观察到，在美国股票市场引入FT后，与低价股相比，高价股中出现了大量微小交易，这些交易通过场外一股交易来衡量。这些微小交易在吸引注意力的事件期间协调一致时，足以对高价股产生巨大的价格压力。进一步证据表明，FT甚至可能助长高价股中类似迷因股的交易狂热和泡沫，其中反馈效应可能发挥作用。（JEL G10, G12, G14, G18, G32, G41）

articles.title_en: The Market Inside the Market: Odd-Lot Quotes
articles.title_cn: 市场内部的市场：零股报价
articles.abstract_en: We show current market practices relating to odd-lot quotes create a large “inside” market where better prices routinely exist relative to the National Best Bid or Offer. We show that odd-lot quotes play a price discovery role, and these quotes provide valuable information to traders with access to proprietary data feeds. Using a XGBoost machine learning algorithm that uses odd-lot data to predict future prices, we demonstrate a simple and profitable trading strategy. We argue the SEC’s proposed round-lot redefinition reduces—but does not eliminate—the high incidence of superior odd-lot quotes within the NBBO.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们展示了当前与零股报价相关的市场实践创造了一个大型“内部”市场，其中相对于全国最优买卖报价，经常存在更好的价格。我们表明零股报价在价格发现中发挥作用，并且这些报价为能够访问专有数据流的交易者提供了有价值的信息。利用XGBoost机器学习算法，该算法使用零股数据预测未来价格，我们展示了一种简单且盈利的交易策略。我们认为，美国证券交易委员会提出的整手股重新定义减少了——但并未消除——NBBO内优越零股报价的高发生率。

articles.title_en: News and Asset Pricing: A High-Frequency Anatomy of the SDF
articles.title_cn: 新闻与资产定价：随机贴现因子的高频解剖
articles.abstract_en: Utilizing real-time newswire data, together with a robustly estimated intraday stochastic discount factor (SDF), we identify and quantify the economic news that is priced. News related to monetary policy and finance on average accounts for most of the variation in the SDF, followed by news about international affairs and macroeconomic data. We also document nontrivial temporal variation in the relative importance of the news, along with marked differences in the estimated news risk premiums in the “factor zoo.” To further highlight the economic mechanisms at work, we associate the different news effects with interest rate, growth, and risk premium shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用实时新闻通讯数据，结合稳健估计的日内随机贴现因子（SDF），我们识别并量化了被定价的经济新闻。与货币政策和金融相关的新闻平均而言解释了SDF的大部分变动，其次是关于国际事务和宏观经济数据的新闻。我们还记录了新闻相对重要性的显著时间变化，以及在“因子动物园”中估计的新闻风险溢价的显著差异。为进一步突出起作用的经济机制，我们将不同的新闻效应与利率、增长和风险溢价冲击联系起来。

articles.title_en: Missing Data in Asset Pricing Panels
articles.title_cn: 资产定价面板中的缺失数据
articles.abstract_en: We propose a simple and computationally attractive method to deal with missing data in in cross-sectional asset pricing using conditional mean imputations and weighted least squares, cast in a generalized method of moments (GMM) framework. This method allows us to use all observations with observed returns; it results in valid inference; and it can be applied in nonlinear and high-dimensional settings. In simulations, we find it performs almost as well as the efficient but computationally costly GMM estimator. We apply our procedure to a large panel of return predictors and find that it leads to improved out-of-sample predictability.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种简单且计算上具有吸引力的方法，用于处理横截面资产定价中的缺失数据，该方法基于条件均值插补和加权最小二乘法，并置于广义矩估计（GMM）框架中。此方法使我们能够利用所有具有观测收益的观测值；它产生有效的推断；并且可以应用于非线性和高维设置。在模拟中，我们发现其表现几乎与高效但计算成本高昂的GMM估计器一样好。我们将此程序应用于一个大的收益预测因子面板，并发现它提高了样本外的可预测性。

articles.abstract_en: We document the widespread nature and structure of missing observations of firm fundamentals and show how to systematically handle them. Missing financial data affects more than 70% of firms that represent about half of the total market cap. Firm fundamentals have complex systematic missing patterns, invalidating traditional approaches to imputation. We propose a novel imputation method to obtain a fully observed panel of firm fundamentals that exploits both time-series and cross-sectional dependency of data to impute missing values and allows for general systematic patterns of missingness. We document important implications for risk premiums estimates, cross-sectional anomalies, and portfolio construction. (JEL C14, C38, C55, G12)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了公司基本面观测值缺失的普遍性和结构，并展示了如何系统地处理这些缺失。缺失财务数据影响了超过70%的公司，这些公司约占市场总市值的一半。公司基本面存在复杂的系统性缺失模式，使得传统的插补方法失效。我们提出了一种新颖的插补方法，以获得完全观测的公司基本面面板数据，该方法利用数据的时间序列和横截面依赖性来插补缺失值，并允许一般的系统性缺失模式。我们记录了这对风险溢价估计、横截面异象和投资组合构建的重要影响。(JEL C14, C38, C55, G12)

articles.title_en: News Diffusion in Social Networks and Stock Market Reactions
articles.title_cn: 社交网络中的新闻传播与股票市场反应
articles.abstract_en: We study how the social transmission of public news influences investors’ beliefs and the securities markets. Using data on social networks, we find that earnings announcements from firms in higher-centrality counties generate a stronger immediate price, volatility, and trading volume reactions. Post-announcement, such firms experience weaker price drift and faster volatility decay but higher and more persistent volume. These findings suggest greater social connectedness facilitates the timely incorporation of news into prices, as well as opinion divergence and excessive trading. We propose the social churning hypothesis, which is confirmed using granular data from StockTwits messages and household trading records.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究公共新闻的社会传播如何影响投资者的信念和证券市场。利用社交网络数据，我们发现，位于更高中心性县的公司发布的盈利公告会引发更强的即时价格、波动性和交易量反应。公告发布后，这些公司的价格漂移较弱，波动性衰减较快，但交易量更高且更持久。这些发现表明，更强的社会连通性有助于新闻及时纳入价格，同时也促进了意见分歧和过度交易。我们提出了社会搅动假说，并通过StockTwits消息和家庭交易记录的细粒度数据予以证实。

articles.abstract_en: How should an investor value financial data? The answer is complicated because it depends on the characteristics of all investors. We develop a sufficient statistics approach that uses equilibrium asset return moments to summarize all relevant information about others’ characteristics. Our approach values public or private data, data about one or many assets, and data relevant for dividends or sentiment. While different data types, of course, have different valuations, heterogeneous investors also value the same data very differently. This finding suggests a low price elasticity for data demand. Heterogeneous investors’ data valuations are also affected very differentially by market illiquidity.
articles.abstract_cn: 投资者应如何评估金融数据的价值？答案复杂，因为它取决于所有投资者的特征。我们开发了一种充分统计量方法，利用均衡资产回报矩来概括关于他人特征的所有相关信息。我们的方法适用于公共或私人数据、关于单一或多个资产的数据，以及与股息或情绪相关的数据。当然，不同类型的数据有不同的估值，但异质投资者对相同数据的估值也差异很大。这一发现表明数据需求的价格弹性较低。异质投资者的数据估值也受到市场非流动性的非常不同的影响。
